# 1 Clement Chapter 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 8

**8:1** The ministers of God's grace spoke by the Holy Spirit concerning repentance.

**8:2** And the Sovereign Lord of all things himself spoke of repentance with an oath: "As I live, says the Lord, I take no pleasure in the death of the sinner but rather in his repentance." And he added this gracious declaration: [Ezek 33:11]

**8:3** "Repent, O house of Israel, from your iniquity. Say to the children of my people: Even though your sins should reach from earth to heaven, and though they be redder than scarlet and blacker than sackcloth, if you turn to me with your whole heart and say 'Father,' I will listen to you as to a holy people." [composite citation]

**8:4** And in another place he says: "Wash yourselves and be clean; remove your evil deeds from before my eyes; cease from your wickedness; learn to do good; pursue justice; rescue the oppressed; give judgment for the orphan and defend the cause of the widow; come now, let us reason together, says the Lord; and if your sins be as crimson, I will make them white as snow; if they be as scarlet, I will make them white as wool; and if you are willing and hear me, you shall eat the good things of the land; but if you refuse and do not hear me, a sword shall devour you; for the mouth of the Lord has spoken these things." [Isa 1:16-20 LXX]

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence; composite citation in 8:3 noted.*
